# How to Collect Video Testimonials from Customers (Without an Agency)

By Ruth Peters March 12, 2026· 10 min read

A written review says "great product." A video testimonial shows a real person, in their own home, holding your product and explaining why they love it. There's no contest when it comes to trust and conversion impact.

But most Shopify merchants never collect video testimonials. The process is too expensive, too manual, or both. You either hire a UGC agency at $150-500 per video, send awkward email requests that go unanswered, or just skip video entirely and rely on star ratings.

There's a simpler path. You can collect video testimonials directly from customers using surveys, with no agency, no production team, and no awkward back-and-forth. A customer gets a survey after their purchase, one of the questions asks for a short video, and they record it on their phone in 30 seconds.

This guide covers why video testimonials matter, why the traditional ways of collecting them don't work for most stores, and how to set up an automated video collection system on Shopify.

## Why video testimonials convert better than written reviews

Written reviews are valuable. They build trust and influence purchase decisions. But video testimonials do something text can't: they transmit emotion, authenticity, and context all at once.

FAQs: Post-Purchase Survey Questions

The sale is not the end of the customer journey. For smart eCommerce brands, it’s the beginning of the next one. The moment a customer clicks “Complete Purchase,” they are at their highest point of engagement. They’re excited, invested, and open to talking. This is your single best opportunity to ask them for feedback.

A post-purchase survey is a simple questionnaire sent right after a customer buys. It provides a direct line to understanding why they bought, how they found you, and what you can do to bring them back. This article explores why these surveys are critical and provides over 100 questions to help you build your own.
